meta.note: Composite patterns = multi-component compositions with structural + ownership contracts. lastReviewed 2026-07-16.

patterns.name: RightRail
patterns.stateOwnership: root owns layout/loading/error boundary; sections own their data

patterns.name: PackageBrowser
patterns.note: 10 curated packages; card selects, Customize pill applies+switches to Customize tab.

patterns.name: MaterialSelector / BottomSelectionTray
patterns.interaction: role=dialog; Esc + outside pointerdown close (except .swatch keeps open for live recolor); staggered tile entrance (reduced-motion honored)

patterns.name: ColorPickerModal
patterns.interaction: role=dialog aria-modal; swatch click previews (onPreview), double-click/Apply commits, cancel reverts; Apply disabled unless picked in library

patterns.name: ThreeDViewportShell
patterns.stateOwnership: byte-driven load; error boundary; controls disabled until ready
patterns.note: no fake interactive snapshot; reduced-motion honored; idles GPU (frameloop never) when covered

patterns.name: MobileSelectionSheet
patterns.note: same API/data as RightRail; bottom sheet with detents, drag handle, focus trap, safe-area, sticky actions, Esc/back close
